scope.notes: Estimated 25-40 production and test files across 3 layers. BACKEND (~12-15 main): compile/CompilePipeline.java (re-port captured attempt loop), CompileStateService.java (captureForCompilation/confirmVersioned onto the live publication with reference_policy + intent version), PromptAssembler.java (assembleCaptured + FR-11 order), InferenceCaptureStore.java, incremental/CompilationPlanner.java, incremental/IncrementalAssembler.java, gateway/GatewayPayloadSerializer.java (FR-11), ContextPromptSection (FR-12), gateway/GenAiLlmGatewayClient.java + GatewayResponseParser (FR-13 usage/thinking), StudioCompileProperties/StudioCompileConfig (flag binding), StudioController + StudioService (v2 PUT on the page path, compile body with mode, mode/reason in the response), compile DTOs. CONTRACT: docs/specs/studio/openapi.yaml `/tests/{id}/compile` (request body + response fields). FRONTEND (~8-10): pages/ChecksStudioPage/ChecksStudioPage.tsx (step IDs, scope affirmation), components/studio/run/useRunGate.ts (mode, confirm, surfaced reason), studio API client + types, review panel (reused/regenerated badges + diff, Rebuild all), MSW handlers/fixtures for INCREMENTAL/FULL/REUSE. TESTS: re-port of the archived StudioVersionedCompilationIT-style ITs plus the CompileBounds/RepairBounds/RepairRedaction/CompileBudgetExpiry suites on the captured path, planner byte-identity tests, and FE component and run-gate tests. This is cross-cutting (BE pipeline + persistence + contract + FE), which clearly exceeds 20 files.

integration.notes: No new external system. Vertex gemini-3.8-flash through the Citi GenAI gateway (GenAiLlmGatewayClient) and studio-runner POST /v1/validate are both already wired. The request shape changes (prefix reorder, optional systemInstruction/thinkingConfig, usage fields), and those capabilities are unverified behind the R2D2 proxy (CON-8, OQ-9, SPK-01), so graceful degradation must be designed. The internal API contract changes: compile gains a body with mode, and the response gains selectedMode/reason/writable/reused IDs. That counts as 'new internal API' behavior. It is not 4 because there are no webhooks/events and no new system.

infrastructure.notes: V18 is present and its JSONB plan/outcome columns can probably hold the FR-13/FR-14 telemetry, so no new table is likely (inferred). Database/schema remains on the critical path: (a) the captured publication must satisfy V24's reference_policy CHECK and identity index, which the archived path predates; (b) the V19 candidate-identity cutover (manual, writer-drain barrier, docs/runbooks/studio-inference-rollout.md) was written before V24 and may need re-anchoring by @data-engineer (CON-9); (c) OQ-1, if amended, changes the baseline query and possibly idx_ui_test_revisions_eligible. Flags: bind studio.compile.incremental.enabled via env (helm configmap), default false. No new container or service. It is not 5 because studio-runner and the artifact version are unchanged (CON-4).

knowledge.notes: The components and tests exist (10.24/10.25/10.26), and C0 is a precise design. The hard part is not in any existing pattern: reconciling two divergent attempt loops. One is the archived capture/budget/planner loop (51ade0f1f). The other is the live typed-intent to Story 10.44 structural reference-policy loop (VersionedIntentDeriver, V21-V24). The fold author explicitly declined this bridge as 'inventing behaviour'. Other open knowledge: Gemini implicit prefix caching and thinkingConfig behavior behind the R2D2 proxy (SPK-01, ASM-2), and fingerprint/pin semantics when the prompt layout changes (ASM-6, C0 §6). It is not 5 because the domain is well documented (C0, implementation plan, review docs in 51ade0f1f).

risk.notes: This changes the compile path that every Studio test goes through. Correctness invariants: a byte-identical locked prefix, and no out-of-scope PATCH acceptance (NFR-3). Security: CSI/authorization boundaries on baseline reuse, and 10.24 AC-8 is still open (OQ-12). Prompts and repair context must stay free of resolved secrets/variables (NFR-5), and this branch also has in-flight secrets/vault changes. FR-11/FR-12 are NOT covered by the incremental flag: they change the live FULL prompt for all users, advance the prompt pin and invalidate every baseline once (ASM-6). The incremental path itself is dark-launched (CON-3), which bounds the blast radius and keeps rollback (flag off selects FULL) cheap. It is not 5 because execution/runner stay untouched (CON-1, NoRuntimeLlmTest) and the flag default is false.

flags: COMPLEX: architectural review required. OQ-4's recommended direction (live v1 page + mode) contradicts C0 §1 and needs a C0 amendment signed by Aria before the spec is written (CON-2).

RE-PORT, NOT RESTORE: 51ade0f1f's CompilePipeline and captured publication cannot be cherry-picked. They must be re-expressed on top of the live typed-intent/reference-policy pipeline (V21-V24, Story 10.44). Research should diff archived runAttempt vs live compile() before the spec fixes an integration seam.
DATA: @data-engineer must confirm that V19 (backend/db/cutover) is still valid after V24, and whether mixed-provenance candidates need V19 applied before enablement (CON-9).

BLAST RADIUS: FR-11/FR-12 (prompt reorder, global-context dedup) affect all compiles regardless of the incremental flag and advance the prompt pin. Gate them on the 10.26 harness (AC-11.2) and decide OQ-10 (ship first, to avoid a second baseline invalidation).

SECURITY: 10.24 AC-8 (cross-CSI/revoked baseline reuse, confirmation binding) is open. Recommend making it a precondition for flag enablement (OQ-12). Extend RepairRedactionTest to the captured repair context, which now carries the rejected proposal (FR-10).

CONTRACT: changing /tests/{id}/compile in docs/specs/studio/openapi.yaml triggers the pinned-contract re-anchor (tools/epic10-fold/pin-contract.sh, confinement.test.ts digest) and the MSW handler update (CON-11).
WORKTREE: 69 uncommitted paths on brunobuger/ui-studio touch adjacent code (studio/dispatch/*, studio/secrets/*, StudioReferenceResolver). Sequence this story after that work lands.

SPLIT RECOMMENDED: (A) inference efficiency FR-11/12/13, standalone ~STANDARD, ship first per OQ-10; (B) backend incremental re-port behind the flag, FR-3..7/10/14; (C) live-page UX FR-2/8/9/15 + MSW. FR-1 (engine map) is documentation for the spec itself.
